enGB: "Watch yerselves." Bell's gun remains fixed on Jaruunika's chest "Hags are masters of deception and we all saw what she was like when we arrived."
"It's a step backwards to be sure..." Bell shurgs. "Still no real harm done. An' we can't really expect that she'd 'ave everything right overnight. Overcoming the worse parts of yerself takes time."

"So she made a mistake" Bell gives Arueshalae a reassuring smile, "We all make 'em. Even the best of us stumble along the way. Redemption's ain't just some switch ya flip an' suddenly yer good. Give her time. The important thing is she's trying ta be better."
"Wow that looks nasty. Why would anyone want ta do that to themselves."

"I don't know what game he's playin' but this guy seems a nasty piece a' work. I doubt we can trust a word he says..." Bell trails off considering. "On the other hand, maybe he does actually wanta die. It'd be no surprise realy. Who'd wanta live as a horrid swarm o' locust like that."
"Ugh not another one. I've seen enough folks transformed inta monsters ta last a lifetime. At least we can kill this wretched thing and put a stop ta this one."
Bell meets the tortured man's gaze."I've seen things like what's been done to ya. I can't promise it'll be easy but we 'elped them and we're gonna help you to. Right partner?"
Bell turns away tears forming in her eyes. "Not again... why are we always too late?"

"Well ain't this quite a sight." Bell waves a hand to encompase the shattered alter and repentant cultists "I had a feeling there was more to this kid than meets the eye but this is something else. I say we follow her lead on this one. Whatever she's got going on it working wonders."

"Another scholar drawn to madness like a moth to a flame." Bell puts her head in her hands "You'd think what with all their knowledge they'd be smart enough ta know that some things are hidden for a reason. Still at least she's only risked herself this time."

"Guys like this really baffle me. I mean why bother preserving this knowledge if ya don't want no one ta have it? Surely it would 'ave be easier to just let the demons destroy it then go through all the trouble to keep it intact only ta stand an eternal guard makin' sure nobody reads it."
"You will never undertand us. You unnatural thing."

Bell clutches her head and winces in pain as you aproach the gate. "Ohh there's something wrong with this place. I can feel it in the air."The guards gaze seems to skip over her as though their minds can't quite register her.
Bell leans forward to whisper in your ear "Hold up a second who's this? I thought you were in charge."
"I thought we were in Sarkoris..." Bell mutters as she steps back
